title: VinaMetalic
description: Fork of AutoDock Vina 1.2.7 with native metal coordination scoring for metalloenzymes: AutoDock4-style 12-6 metal-donor pair term, coordination-number penalty and bounded geometry bonus with analytic gradients, plus automatic receptor-bound occupancy detection. Byte-identical to upstream Vina 1.2.7 when no parametrized metal is present.
